newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers light, heavy load power Sun to Tues.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers light, heavy load power Sun to Tues.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered up to 200 megawatts (MW) of firm power during both light and heavy loads hours for Sunday through Tuesday, the federal agency said Friday.
BPA also offered up to 200 MW of non-firm power during light-load hours on Sunday through Tuesday.

The agency lowered its price for firm power during heavy-load hours (0600-2200 PST) to $24.25 per megawatt hour (MWh) in the Northwest, compared with $26.00 for Friday and Saturday schedulings. Offers for California-Oregon border (COB) deliveries were cut to $25.00 from #$27.00.
BPA's price for all firm light-load hour deliveries on Sunday through Tuesday was $19.00 per MWh.
The agency also offered up to 200 MW of non-firm power during hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 on Sunday through Tuesday at $19.50 for both Northwest and COB deliveries.
Non-firm offers for hours ending 0600 and 2300 were $24.00 for Northwest deals and $25.50 for COB.
